## Rodent Control

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
d <- read_csv("C:/Users/glenm/Downloads/311_Service_Requests_20261123.csv")
```

```{r}
d_clean <- d %>%
  # Remove rows flagged as duplicates (keeps FALSE and any NAs)
  filter(!DUPLICATE | is.na(DUPLICATE)) %>%
  # Parse CREATED_DATE (MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS AM/PM) and keep 2022+
  mutate(CREATED_DATE_PARSED = mdy_hms(CREATED_DATE)) %>%
  filter(year(CREATED_DATE_PARSED) >= 2022)

d_small <- d_clean %>%
  select(
    SR_NUMBER, STATUS, ORIGIN,
    CREATED_DATE_PARSED, CLOSED_DATE,
    CREATED_HOUR, CREATED_DAY_OF_WEEK, CREATED_MONTH,
    COMMUNITY_AREA, WARD, ZIP_CODE, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    STATUS = as.factor(STATUS),
    ORIGIN = as.factor(ORIGIN)
  )

# Check new RAM size
format(object.size(d_small), units = "MB")

# Comes out to about 50MB

# Save compressed for GitHub
saveRDS(d_small, "chicago_rodents_2022_2026.rds", compress = "xz")

# Check exact file size on disk (in MB)
file.size("chicago_rodents_2022_2026.rds") / 1024^2
```
